policy: Per START_HERE_ZH.md and CLEAN_PIPELINE.md, the fixed scale C must come from one of four explicitly identified candidates. Per-image min-max is prohibited as the primary scale. No candidate may be pre-selected as PRIMARY; the primary scale is determined by a complete validation-based selection protocol that requires separate decoder training and a complete validation sweep per candidate.
lock_status: UNLOCKED — no scale value can be locked for paper use until the validation-based selection protocol (Section below) has been executed across all viable candidates.

domain_physical_fixed_C.description: A scale constant derived from a physical source: scanner DICOM field, vendor manual, or simulation definition. This is the only candidate that can be called a 'physical constant'.

brainweb.status: PENDING — BrainWeb PET simulation activity is a digital-phantom quantity with no published Bq/mL constant. Either contact the BrainWeb authors or accept that no domain-physical C exists for this dataset.

hecktor.status: PENDING — the traceability arrays are declared as reconstructed PET exported directly from DICOM and currently labelled SUV. The exact export unit/rescale provenance must be verified before deciding whether a machine-derived constant such as ~30000 applies to this representation. This normalization issue is separate from image geometry.

domain_physical_fixed_C.eligibility: If a value with a recorded source exists for a dataset, it is a candidate. It is NOT automatically PRIMARY — it must still go through the validation-based selection protocol below.

train_derived_zero_offset_fixed_C.description: A scale constant derived from the training set as the global maximum of all ingested train raw_activity arrays (after the approved spatial transform). Zero offset. This is a data-derived fixed scale, NOT a physical constant.

brainweb.derivation_rule: max over all train raw_activity arrays for brainweb after mean_pool_2x2_full_square.
brainweb.status: PENDING — compute via sam-kem calibrate-normalization on train only.

hecktor.derivation_rule: max over all train raw_activity arrays for hecktor after resize_full_square_to_128.

train_derived_zero_offset_fixed_C.eligibility: Valid candidate. May become the PRIMARY scale after the validation-based selection protocol below selects it. Must never be called a 'physical constant'.

train_global_minmax_sensitivity.description: A per-dataset [min_train, max_train] scale with non-zero offset. Validation values are clipped to [min_train, max_train].

brainweb.derivation_rule: [min, max] over train raw_activity for brainweb.

hecktor.derivation_rule: [min, max] over train raw_activity for hecktor.

train_global_minmax_sensitivity.eligibility: Sensitivity arm. May become the PRIMARY scale after the validation-based selection protocol below selects it. The non-zero offset is a documented data-derived choice, not a physical claim.

per_image_minmax_diagnostic_only.description: Per-image [min, max] normalization, computed independently for every image.
per_image_minmax_diagnostic_only.eligibility: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY. Never eligible as the primary scale because it destroys between-case quantitative comparability.

validation_based_selection_protocol.step_1: For each viable candidate, regenerate train+validation inputs with that candidate's C.
validation_based_selection_protocol.step_2: Train a separate pair of dataset-specific decoders (BW + HE) under that candidate's C.
validation_based_selection_protocol.step_3: Run the complete validation hyperparameter sweep under that candidate's C.
validation_based_selection_protocol.step_4: Compare candidate results by subject-level NRMSE + SSIM plus clipping rate on validation only.
validation_based_selection_protocol.step_5: If a candidate wins, it becomes the PRIMARY scale for that dataset. It may be called a data-derived fixed scale. Only domain_physical_fixed_C, if selected, may be called a physical constant.
validation_based_selection_protocol.step_6: Locked hyperparameters and final primary scale are recorded in code/configs/experiment.yaml under normalization.scale_constants.<dataset> and frozen before any test_locked ingestion.

forbidden_uses: Per-dataset arbitrary constant (e.g. 30000) without recorded source.
Test-set-derived constant (must never be opened before freeze).
Pre-declaring any candidate as PRIMARY before the validation-based selection protocol has run.

current_yaml_state._comment: These remain null until the validation-based selection protocol has produced a winner. They will be set to the winner's value at that point, and the protocol SHA will be recorded alongside.
